title: The Red Cellar
turn: Ruby finds the banned red wine in her cellar and learns Justin hid it there for Candy.

needs.text: Justin is the tavern's cook and Ruby's ex
Candy pays Justin to keep crates in the cellar
The crates hold red wine the city has banned

characters.name: Candy
traits: grins at everyone, never pays on time

infos.text: The tavern terrace sits above the busy docks of Vessan.
Justin is the tavern's cook and Ruby's ex.
Candy pays Justin to keep crates in the cellar.
The crates hold red wine the city has banned.
Someone with a key changed the cellar lock three nights ago.

beats.what: Ruby wipes the bar, unimpressed, while Candy leans over the counter, grinning at a stranger's tab.
Justin, shouting orders from the kitchen, hears the docks bell ring far below the terrace.
Ruby mentions the cook she once loved, while his apron still hangs by the back door.
Candy names the rent she pays Justin to keep crates out of sight in the cellar.
Ruby checks a crate stamp in the cellar and sees the red vintage the city banned.
Justin says out loud that he wants out of the deal, and Ruby warns that the guard fines anyone caught with red wine.
Does Justin hide the crates for Candy or confess everything to Ruby?
Ruby goes down to the cellar and finds the crates stacked where Justin swore none were kept.
Candy warns that the guard will take the tavern's license if Ruby reports the cellar.
Does Ruby report the cellar to the guard or cover for Justin?
At dawn the guard's list is posted at the docks, with Justin's name written on it.

links.label: Justin's confession sets up the hide-or-confess choice
Candy's warning sets up the report-or-cover choice
Candy's grin returns when Ruby finds the crates
The banned vintage comes back to haunt the docks
